args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity), 0) FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND si.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE city = 'Vienna')) AS total_available FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.brand = 'Black+Decker' AND pf.product_family_name = 'Black+Decker Home GTC 3PT-1Y9 Cordless Drill Driver' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'voltage' AND pvp.property_value_text = '20 V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'battery platform' AND pvp.property_value_text = '20v-system') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'kit contents' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'starter kit');
SELECT store_id, record_path FROM stores WHERE city = 'Vienna';
